inventory_coverage: metadata plus explicitly requested bounded content evidence

limitations: Manifest and registry declarations are untrusted; no build, process use, exclusive ownership or recovery is verified.
Only Cargo/npm direct path declarations and literal workspace members are extracted; conditional, inherited, patched, remote and glob relationships are incomplete.
Hashes cover explicitly selected regular files only. Matching digests do not establish that either copy is unnecessary.

plan.required_approval: No executable operations. A future exact manifest requires separate approval.

limitations: Windows local drives only; network shares, alternate data streams and directory allocation are excluded.
Not an atomic filesystem snapshot. Concurrent same-size writes with preserved timestamps can escape detection.
Open handles temporarily deny rename/deletion; scans can fail when other handles deny sharing.
No process-reference, exclusive ownership, executed-build provenance or recovery verification. Optional declarations and hashes remain evidence only.
File reads may affect access timestamps through OS policy; no source content, last-write time, Git or configuration writes are requested.
Allocated sizes are filesystem-reported per-file allocation, not promised reclaimable space; deduplication/compression/shared extents can differ.
Concurrency is bounded to one worker. Cancellation is checked between operations; a blocked filesystem call cannot be interrupted.
